name: Ascended
text: In the aftermath sequence, this fighter is always considered to be Marked for Greatness. The Daemon within refuses to be equipped with any equipment, weapons or armour.

name: Hollowed
text: This fighter automatically passes any Bravery tests it is required to take.

name: Baleful Challenge
text: Select a visible enemy fighter within 1" of this fighter. That enemy fighter makes a free melee attack action targeting this fighter. Then, add 2 to the Attacks and Fight characteristic of melee attack actions made by this fighter that target that enemy fighter until the end of the activation.

name: Puppet Master
text: *Magical ability*. Select a visible fighter within 6" of this fighter. That fighter must pass a Bravery test or immediately make a free Move, Retreat, or Attack action of your choice (a friendly fighter can choose to automatically fail the Bravery test).

name: Curse of Agony
text: *Magical ability*. Select a visible fighter within 12" of this fighter and roll (X) dice. For each result of 2+, allocate 1 damage point to that fighter.

name: Touch of Chaos
text: *Magical ability*. Select a visible fighter within 1" of this fighter. That fighter must take a Bravery test. If the test fails, the fighter is immediately removed from the battlefield. The fighter does not count as taken out of action, but gains the `MUTANT` keyword.
